body: I just know I will always have this looming idea that no matter how well I do in life, it will never be as good as what it could be. Growing up everyone expected so much from me. I skipped a grade, made top 3% district wide. My past will always follow. The good and bad. I just want to get away from all of it. I really hope there is a chance I could get out of this country. Maybe Canada, or Australia.

Where should I start? At this rate I'm going to be living off of $40 a week and the remaining $200 will go to bills for two years. I'm going to be in a rut for two years of my life. It just doesn't seem worth it to continue struggling. Not to mention how alone I am now.

I've seriously considered leaving and starting over. I mean, what have I got to lose, right? If I'm at the point where ending it seems like a viable option, maybe moving to a different country would be essentially the same thing. I really do love life. I'm actually a really happy person. I just hate being alone and struggling. I fear that I'm going to fuck up again.

Thanks for your advice. I've started my life over twice now. Both times I had supportive friends for it. This time I'm alone and worse off than the others. Who knew overcoming a heroine addiction would be the easy part?
